problem_text:
A shipping company must allocate cargo space for six distinct categories of freight, each necessitating six sequential handling stages for preparation and loading. The revenue generated per ton for each freight category is listed below:
* For Freight Alpha, revenue is 19.809 per ton
* For Freight Beta, revenue is 17.922 per ton
* For Freight Gamma, revenue is 6.783 per ton
* For Freight Delta, revenue is 9.753 per ton
* For Freight Epsilon, revenue is 5.341 per ton
* For Freight Zeta, revenue is 16.006 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each stage is as follows:
* For Freight Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 0.235 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.795 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.548 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.945 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.312 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.76 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Beta, Stage 1 consumes 0.901 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.294 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.582 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.48 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.844 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.703 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.339 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.297 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.839 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.823 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.562 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.41 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.213 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.647 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.942 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.255 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.644 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.543 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 0.898 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.844 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.422 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.831 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.519 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.309 (ton-hours)
* For Freight Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.376 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.225 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.022 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.197 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.769 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.093 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling time for Stage 1 must remain within 60.406 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 2 must remain within 59.646 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 3 must remain within 75.853 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 4 must remain within 105.089 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 5 must remain within 103.208 hours
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 6 must remain within 75.242 hours

Under the stipulation that the total processing duration for each individual stage—Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4, Stage 5, and Stage 6—does not surpass its allocated time capacity, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each freight category to maximize total revenue.
